title: GameHub Test Coverage
summary: Implement a robust, prioritized test suite for the GameHub monorepo with focus on deterministic game logic, room lifecycle, API behavior, and core UI flows.
nonGoals: End-to-end multiplayer tests that require real Redis, sockets, or browser automation (unless explicitly requested later).
qualityGates: All new tests are deterministic and avoid real Redis/network usage (use in-memory mocks or dependency injection).
`services/hub` tests run via `npm test` without requiring external services.
`services/web` tests run via `npm test` and use jsdom-safe APIs.
Test failures include clear, actionable messages.

stories.title: Complete test inventory and prioritize coverage
stories.description: Finish `test-roadmap.md` Phase 0 by mapping major functional areas to files, listing critical game paths, and enumerating must-test APIs/socket events.
acceptanceCriteria: `test-roadmap.md` lists each major service area with concrete file paths.
Critical game paths are listed per game (start, turn progression, win detection, scoring).
API endpoints and socket events are enumerated with source file references.

stories.title: Add hub test helpers and Redis mock
stories.description: Create test utilities for `services/hub` to stub Redis and control time (e.g., fake timers), enabling deterministic tests for room and Wordle daily logic.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable in-memory Redis mock is added for `services/hub` tests.
Tests can swap Redis without touching production code paths in most cases (minimal DI or module mocking).
A helper exists to control time for date-based Wordle daily tests.

stories.title: Expand Catan resources and scoring unit tests
stories.description: Add unit tests for `services/hub/src/games/catan/catanResources.js` and `catanScoring.js` including discard logic, bank trade ratios, monopoly/year-of-plenty, and victory point calculation/longest road edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover resource bundle math, discard validation, and trade validation.
Tests cover victory point calculation and longest road holder updates.
All tests run without network or Redis.

stories.title: Add UNO service unit tests
stories.description: Create tests for `services/hub/src/games/uno/unoService.js` covering game start, playable actions, draw/skip/reverse/draw2/draw4, color choice, UNO call penalty, and end-game detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover at least one happy path and multiple invalid action paths.
Color choice and pending draw rules are validated.
Winner detection and phase transitions are verified.

stories.title: Add Crazy Eights service unit tests
stories.description: Create tests for `services/hub/src/games/crazy_eights/crazyEightsService.js` covering start, playability rules, draw/pass behavior, suit declaration with eights, and win detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover playability by rank/suit and the special 8 rules.
Draw and pass behavior is validated when no moves exist.
Winner detection ends the game phase.

stories.title: Add Wordle daily flow tests
stories.description: Write tests for `services/hub/src/games/wordle/wordleDaily.js` covering start, guess validation, win/lose outcomes, leaderboard/entry writes, and status queries using the Redis mock and controlled time.
acceptanceCriteria: Start/guess flows validate error cases (missing name, invalid length/word, already played).
Win and lose outcomes update stats and leaderboard entries.
`getDailyStatus` returns expected fields for player and anonymous queries.

stories.title: Add hub API tests for Fastify endpoints
stories.description: Add tests for `services/hub/src/server.js` endpoints using Fastify inject; verify request validation and response shapes for rooms and Wordle endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover `/api/rooms` and `/api/rooms/by-code/:code` happy + error paths.
Tests cover Wordle daily start/guess errors and `/api/wordle/free/word` response shape.
Server can be instantiated in tests without starting a real listener.

stories.title: Add web UI routing and HubHome tests
stories.description: Expand `services/web` tests to cover App routing and HubHome interactions with mocked navigation and fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: App routing renders expected screens for key routes.
HubHome join/create flows call navigation appropriately.
Tests run under Vitest with jsdom and no real network calls.

stories.title: Add lightweight coverage guardrails and test docs
stories.description: Document how to run hub/web tests and add optional coverage thresholds or guidance without slowing dev workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: README or a testing doc explains how to run hub/web tests and what they cover.
Optional: add a lightweight coverage target note or script (non-blocking).
